content:
maria: Quick sync  compact form rows in Routes editor  inline errors vs single summary? Screenshot: https://img.example/route-compact.png

alex: inline for single-field errors. summary when many. hybrid sounds best.

jess: agree hybrid. Rule: show inline if <=2 errors; show condensed summary pill if >2. Pill opens flyout with quick-jump links.

dinesh: accessibility: move focus to summary on submit when present; inline errors must use aria-describedby and role="alert".

sam: required markers: visual asterisk + legend text saying "Fields marked * are required" and sr-only per control. Also set aria-required="true".

aria-bot: a11y checklist:
- focus management for summary
- aria-describedby for inputs
- announce error count when summary focused
- don't rely on color alone (add icon)

alex: delete flow: product wants stronger guards for shared routes. Options: typed confirm, checkbox+confirm, or undo toast.

dinesh: gate typed-confirm when dependent_services_count > 1; else checkbox+undo. Validate typed-confirm on server.
